kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نستسأل (form X)
# نُسْتَسْأَلُ (nustasʔalu) /nus.tas.ʔa.lu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَسْأَلَ (istasʔala)
# نُسْتَسْأَلَ (nustasʔala) /nus.tas.ʔa.la/: first-person plural non-past passive subjunctive of اِسْتَسْأَلَ (istasʔala)
# نُسْتَسْأَلْ (nustasʔal) /nus.tas.ʔal/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِسْتَسْأَلَ (istasʔala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
